description: Occupancy matrix of the region packages shipped in Klacks.Api/deploy/onprem/regions, captured as the state of record. Each entry of occupiedCells is 'scope|location|field' and means: that package field is present and non-null (an empty list counts as empty). fieldOccupancyCounts holds every declared field with the number of locations that fill it - the denominator is countryPackageCount for the scopes profile, worktime, compliance, enforcement and enforcementRules, industryBlockCount for industryProfile and presetCount for preset. unseededFields repeats every field whose count is zero, together with the reason - deliberate gaps must be written down here, never left out silently. RegionPackageCoverageMatrixTests diffs all three sections and names the country, industry, preset and field of every change. For a small change apply the cells the failure message lists; for a bulk change such as a new country package, re-derive the whole file from the packages with a script instead of editing 2000+ sorted entries by hand.

unseededFields.compliance|counterRules: KNOWN GAP: the K18 counter-rule entity import is offered by the schema but seeded by NO country package at compliance level. The only counter rules that exist anywhere are industry-scoped (ch/security and it/facility), so the country-wide counter-rule evaluator runs unseeded on every one of the 30 packages.
unseededFields.compliance|qualifications: Qualification catalogs are shipped per industry block (industryProfiles.<slug>.qualificationCatalog, occupied in 150 of 150 blocks) instead of at compliance level.
unseededFields.enforcementRules|maxConsecutiveDays: Enforcement lever never overridden per rule; the country-wide enforcement.defaultMode applies.
unseededFields.enforcementRules|maxDailyHours: Enforcement lever never overridden per rule; the country-wide enforcement.defaultMode applies.
unseededFields.enforcementRules|maxWeeklyHours: Enforcement lever never overridden per rule; the country-wide enforcement.defaultMode applies.
unseededFields.enforcementRules|minRestDays: Enforcement lever never overridden per rule; the country-wide enforcement.defaultMode applies.
unseededFields.enforcementRules|minRestHours: Enforcement lever never overridden per rule; the country-wide enforcement.defaultMode applies.
unseededFields.enforcementRules|periodCap: KNOWN GAP: periodCaps rows are seeded by 27 of 30 packages, but not one of them pins the enforcement mode of the periodCap evaluator; it always falls back to defaultMode.
unseededFields.enforcementRules|restDayRotation: KNOWN GAP: restDayRotations rows exist in 2 packages plus 3 industry blocks, but no package pins the enforcement mode of the restDayRotation evaluator.
unseededFields.preset|defaultWorkingHours: Set only at country level (worktime.defaultWorkingHours, 30 of 30); never per preset.
unseededFields.preset|guaranteedHours: SchedulingRule column offered by the preset schema but set by no package; presets fall through to the global settings chain for it.
unseededFields.preset|maxOptimalGap: SchedulingRule column offered by the preset schema but set by no package; presets fall through to the global settings chain for it.
unseededFields.preset|maxWorkDays: SchedulingRule column offered by the preset schema but set by no package; presets fall through to the global settings chain for it.
unseededFields.preset|maximumHours: SchedulingRule column offered by the preset schema but set by no package; presets fall through to the global settings chain for it.
unseededFields.preset|minimumHours: SchedulingRule column offered by the preset schema but set by no package; presets fall through to the global settings chain for it.
unseededFields.preset|overtime: Tiered overtime block is offered per preset but set by no package.
unseededFields.preset|rateRevisions: Dated rate revisions are offered per preset but set by no package, so every shipped preset carries a single timeless rate set.
unseededFields.preset|vacationDaysPerYear: Set only at country level (worktime.vacationDaysPerYear, 29 of 30); never per preset.
unseededFields.preset|we3Rate: Third weekend surcharge tier is offered per preset but set by no package, while we1Rate and we2Rate are each set by exactly one preset.
unseededFields.profile|activeIndustries: No shipped package arms a subset of industries, so all five industry slugs stay selectable. RegionSetupService.AddActiveIndustriesSettings reads this field but never receives a value.
unseededFields.profile|macros: No shipped package ships calculation macros, although RegionSetupService.BuildMacroDesired imports them when present.
unseededFields.profile|package: By design: deploy/onprem/regions/README.md states the marketplace sets this block when a package is downloaded, so no checked-in example file carries it and RegionSetupService.AddPackageIdentitySettings records no identity for a locally shipped file.
unseededFields.profile|seedDemoShiftsAndGroups: All 30 shipped onprem packages set seedDemoData to false (no demo data at all), so the narrower seedDemoShiftsAndGroups switch never gets exercised by a checked-in package; it only matters for a locally authored profile that opts into seedDemoData: true.
unseededFields.worktime|fullTime: Contract hour bands are not part of any country worktime default; they stay on the global settings chain.
unseededFields.worktime|guaranteedHours: Contract hour bands are not part of any country worktime default; they stay on the global settings chain.
unseededFields.worktime|maximumHours: Contract hour bands are not part of any country worktime default; they stay on the global settings chain.
unseededFields.worktime|minimumHours: Contract hour bands are not part of any country worktime default; they stay on the global settings chain.
